attributes.content: G1 pinned column under the sticky header

attributes.text: This column sticks 24px below the site header at desktop only. At tablet and mobile it must compute position static.

Every batch is mixed by hand, rested overnight and baked to order, so the dough has time to develop and the edges crisp up while the middle stays soft. This paragraph is here to make the page tall.
